title: Re-add StudyActivityChart with proper webpack config
body: The chart was removed because recharts@3.x pulls in @napi-rs/canvas (native Node.js binary) through victory-vendor, causing webpack browser build failures. To re-add: (1) Add 'recharts' and 'victory-vendor' to the browser externals in next.config.js alongside @napi-rs/canvas and undici, OR (2) Find an alternative chart library without native dependencies, OR (3) Make the chart a server component that renders to an image before sending to client.
rationale: The stats page chart is a valuable UX feature that was in task 2447. It should be re-implemented properly in a follow-up PR.
